one_line: A master painter from the Alchi workshops, embodying the anonymous artists who created the great murals of Ladakh.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but sturdy build from mountain life and long hours at work.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, medium brown Himalayan complexion, slightly sun-reddened nose and cheeks, fine straight brows, large attentive anime-style eyes with a calm, focused gaze, and a gentle half-smile that suggests quiet pride and concentration.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair gathered into a low knot at the back of the head, wrapped with a narrow dark red woolen headband; a few shorter strands escape at the temples, and the headband’s ends hang slightly behind the ear on one side.
appearance.costume: A practical, era-plausible Western Himalayan outfit: an inner off-white, long-sleeved cotton shirt with a simple round collar; over it a knee-length, wrap-style woolen chuba (robe) in muted warm brown, crossing left over right and secured at the waist with a wide woven sash in deep red and dull gold stripes; the chuba’s sleeves are slightly loose and can be rolled back to the forearm, and a hint of pale lining shows at the cuffs; below, ankle-length dark charcoal wool trousers taper into sturdy brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes suitable for mountain paths; over one shoulder is a narrow, faded blue cotton scarf used as a paint rag; small, modest metal hoop earrings and a simple black-and-red woven wrist cord reference Kashmiri and Himalayan ornament without ostentation.
appearance.signature: A long, narrow wooden painting board held in the left arm, with a row of small clay pigment cups in red, blue, green, and yellow along one edge, and a single fine-tipped brush in the right hand, its handle stained from years of use.

ref_desc: Tashi of Alchi is a lean late-twenties Himalayan painter with an oval, sun-kissed face, black hair in a low knot wrapped by a dark red headband, wearing an off-white shirt under a warm brown wool chuba with red-gold sash, charcoal trousers and brown boots, carrying a pigment-filled wooden painting board and fine brush in a palette of warm brown, deep red, off-white, charcoal grey and muted blue.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Tashi of Alchi, a lean late-twenties Himalayan artist: oval sun-browned face, high cheekbones, large attentive eyes and a gentle half-smile, with straight black hair tied in a low knot bound by a dark red wool headband and a few loose strands at the temples. He wears an off-white long-sleeved cotton shirt, over it a knee-length warm brown wrap-style wool chuba crossing left over right, cinched with a wide deep red and dull gold striped woven sash; the chuba sleeves are slightly loose with a hint of pale lining at the cuffs. Show ankle-length charcoal wool trousers tucked into sturdy brown leather boots with slightly upturned toes. Over one shoulder hangs a narrow faded blue cotton scarf used as a paint rag, and he has small simple metal hoop earrings and a black-and-red woven wrist cord. In his left arm he cradles a long narrow wooden painting board with tiny clay cups of red, blue, green and yellow pigments along one edge, while his right hand holds a single fine-tipped brush stained from years of use. Use a restrained palette of warm brown, deep red, off-white, charcoal grey and muted blue, and present him from multiple angles but always with the same face, hair, clothing and signature painting tools.
